newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SHK & Co says rights issue oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: SHK & Co says rights issue oversubscribed.

text.p: Sun Hung Kai & Co Ltd said on Friday its HK$498 million rights issue has been oversubscribed.
The company said it received applications for a total 298.75 million rights shares compared with 264.17 million shares available for subscription.
In October, the company launched a rights issue of share in the proportion of two rights shares for every five existing shares held at HK$1.80 per share.
It said net proceeds will be used to cut debt and for working capital to expand the company's existing businesses.
